patterns: How many members attended GP events each year?
members attended GP events by year
members who went to GP events by year
sql:
SELECT
  e.year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ea.member_id)::int AS members_attended
FROM event_attendance ea
JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.is_gp_event = true
  AND ea.checked_in = true
GROUP BY e.year
ORDER BY e.year
description: Count of distinct members who checked in to GP events, grouped by year

patterns: Top 10 hotels by total bookings across all events
Show me the top hotels by bookings
sql:
SELECT
  h.hotel_name,
  COUNT(*)::int AS total_bookings
FROM room_bookings rb
JOIN hotels h ON rb.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
WHERE rb.room_booked = true
GROUP BY h.hotel_id, h.hotel_name
ORDER BY total_bookings DESC
LIMIT 10
description: Top 10 hotels ranked by total room bookings

patterns: Show the gender split for each zone
sql:
SELECT
  z.zone_name,
  m.gender,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)::int AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN event_attendance ea ON m.member_id = ea.member_id
JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
JOIN zones z ON e.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE m.gender IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY z.zone_name, m.gender
ORDER BY z.zone_name, m.gender
description: Member count by gender for each zone

patterns: Which members attended every GP event?
members who attended all GP events
sql:
WITH gp_events AS (
  SELECT event_id
  FROM events
  WHERE is_gp_event = true
),
gp_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total
  FROM gp_events
)
SELECT
  m.member_id,
  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ea.event_id)::int AS events_attended
FROM members m
JOIN event_attendance ea ON m.member_id = ea.member_id
JOIN gp_events ge ON ea.event_id = ge.event_id
WHERE ea.checked_in = true
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ea.event_id) = (SELECT total FROM gp_count)
ORDER BY m.last_name, m.first_name
LIMIT 200
description: Members who checked in to every GP event

sql:
WITH zone_families AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    z.zone_name,
    m.family_id,
    f.member_count
  FROM members m
  JOIN event_attendance ea ON m.member_id = ea.member_id
  JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
  JOIN zones z ON e.zone_id = z.zone_id
  JOIN families f ON m.family_id = f.family_id
)
SELECT
  zone_name,
  ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS avg_family_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT family_id)::int AS families
FROM zone_families
GROUP BY zone_name
ORDER BY avg_family_size DESC
description: Average family member count by zone

patterns: how many members in each state
sql:
SELECT
  ma.state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.member_id)::int AS member_count
FROM member_addresses ma
WHERE ma.is_current = true
  AND ma.state IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ma.state
ORDER BY member_count DESC
LIMIT 200
description: Member count by current address state

sql:
SELECT
  h.hotel_name,
  rt.canonical_name AS room_type,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.stayed_in_room THEN 1 END)::int AS stayed,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.room_booked THEN 1 END)::int AS booked,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.room_booked THEN 1 END) > 0
    THEN ROUND(
      100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.stayed_in_room THEN 1 END)
      / COUNT(CASE WHEN rb.room_booked THEN 1 END), 1
    )
    ELSE 0
  END AS utilization_pct
FROM room_bookings rb
JOIN hotels h ON rb.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
JOIN room_types rt ON rb.room_type_id = rt.room_type_id
GROUP BY h.hotel_name, rt.canonical_name
ORDER BY h.hotel_name, rt.canonical_name
description: Room utilization percentage by hotel and room type

patterns: Which zones had the most returned attendees?
sql:
WITH member_event_counts AS (
  SELECT ea.member_id, e.zone_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ea.event_id)::int AS events_attended
  FROM event_attendance ea
  JOIN events e ON ea.event_id = e.event_id
  WHERE ea.checked_in = true AND e.zone_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ea.member_id, e.zone_id
),
returning_members AS (
  SELECT zone_id, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)::int AS returning_attendees
  FROM member_event_counts
  WHERE events_attended > 1
  GROUP BY zone_id
)
SELECT z.zone_name, rm.returning_attendees
FROM returning_members rm
JOIN zones z ON rm.zone_id = z.zone_id
ORDER BY rm.returning_attendees DESC
LIMIT 200
